integrity: The proof uses a bijection with ordered breadth-first plane forests, and a finite independent exact-integer checker corroborates the first nine dimensions. No independent mathematical audit performed.
scientific_limitations: The rational recursion gives exact joint rank-depth coefficients, with a closed formula only on the depth-equals-rank boundary. It does not give the full joint distribution of every iterate rank. Prior work establishes the forest correspondence and separate rank/potency enumerations; priority relative to inaccessible weighted-tree literature is uncertain. Exhaustive computations only checked n up to nine; proof is symbolic and combinatorial.
title: Joint image-rank and stabilization-depth census in Catalan transformation monoids
